cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station lounge bar — seated on a chair; a private zero-gravity rest alcove aboard a civilian orbital hotel — catching a drifting square cushion during a gentle weightless turn; a quiet panoramic commuter train curving around an orbital habitat — savoring a flaky breakfast pastry on the way home; a desert oasis at golden hour — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; a neon-lit game arcade — holds a smartphone at chest height; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing with one foot up on a step; a night observatory under an open dome — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — sitting on the ground; her bedroom — standing; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — kneeling on the ground; the grand lobby and staircase of an opera house — holds her keepsake up beside her face
